    //==
    // # Magnitude

    // (|x|)' = sign(x) * x'. Precondition: IValue is non-zero, where the
    // absolute value has no derivative.
    Abs(x: DualNumber): DualNumber
        => (x.Value.Abs, x.Value.Sign.ToNumber * x.Derivative);
